title: the Glass Steppe Rising Again
author: Vesper Nystrom
blurb: Juniper Crane, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
